steps.title: Define application configuration and metadata
steps.description: Formulate the meta-specification of the animated application, setting the proper identity parameters.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure permissions, landscape orientation settings, and launch settings using standard materials theme.

steps.title: Set up Gradle Build Configuration
steps.description: Configure AGP, Gradle properties, Target SDK, Source compatibility parameters, and project-specific namespaces.

steps.title: Establish resource strings
steps.description: Declare system string variables and resource labels.

steps.title: Create tab buttons backgrounds
steps.description: Design custom drawable shapes representing selected and non-selected UI components.

steps.title: Create cards and container styling
steps.description: Design custom geometric background definitions using XML properties for shadow, borders, and gradients.

steps.title: Implement Interpolator Curve Graphics View
steps.description: Program a custom Canvas renderer to display real-time interpolator graphs and frame markers.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Gravity Engine Canvas
steps.description: Design a custom canvas sandbox calculating offline gravity physics, velocity buffers, and physical boundaries bounce coefficient.

steps.title: Implement Canvas Particle Exploder Sandbox
steps.description: Design a custom view that dynamically spawns custom particle clusters on user touch inputs with gravity and alpha fading curves.

steps.title: Design user interface XML layout
steps.description: Create activity layouts defining control tabs, sliders, spinboxes, visualizer surfaces, and action triggers.

steps.title: Implement Primary View Controller Activity
steps.description: Assemble property animations, tab selection logic, listener callbacks, and link controllers to canvas systems.

steps.title: Building Animation Sandbox
steps.description: Run compiler tasks, bundle resource layout trees, and generate debug binary.
